# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6 B2, vassal of the sultan (1371-1381). Generated by gen_vassal_andronikos.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Marks a once-only event and fires it; the second fires a repeatable one.
oe_vas_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_vas_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.$n$
}
oe_vas_fire_again = {
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.$n$
}
# BYZ scope. The sultan's patience 0-100.
oe_vas_add_patience = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_vas_patience add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_vas_patience min = 0 max = 100 }
}
oe_vas_set_patience = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_patience value = $value$ }
}
# BYZ scope. Saves the people of this track as scopes for event texts.
oe_vas_scopes = {
    var:oe_vas_emp ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_e }
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_h }
    var:oe_vas_second ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_s }
    var:oe_vas_grand ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_g }
    var:oe_vas_tson ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_t }
    c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_vas_su } }
}
# BYZ scope. At acceptance: the emperor and their two eldest sons, once (a son who dies is not replaced, so the two
# never become the same person). The heir's eldest son is looked for again whenever there is none yet.
oe_vas_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_emp } has_ruler = yes }
        ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_vas_pr }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_emp value = scope:oe_vas_pr }
        scope:oe_vas_pr = {
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_female = no owner = c:BYZ }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 0
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_vas_p1
            }
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_female = no owner = c:BYZ }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_vas_p2
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_p1 } set_variable = { name = oe_vas_heir value = scope:oe_vas_p1 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_p2 } set_variable = { name = oe_vas_second value = scope:oe_vas_p2 } }
    }
    oe_vas_pick_grand = yes
}
oe_vas_pick_grand = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_vas_grand ?= { is_alive = yes } } var:oe_vas_heir ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        var:oe_vas_heir = {
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_female = no }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 0
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_vas_p3
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_p3 } set_variable = { name = oe_vas_grand value = scope:oe_vas_p3 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The sultan's eldest adult son who is not the Ottoman heir (the partner of the plot).
oe_vas_pick_tson = {
    c:TUR ?= {
        ruler ?= {
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes is_female = no owner = c:TUR NOT = { is_heir_of = c:TUR } }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 0
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_vas_p4
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_p4 } set_variable = { name = oe_vas_tson value = scope:oe_vas_p4 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py).
oe_vas_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage } oe_vas_can_offer = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_offered months = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.1
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage } oe_vas_tick = yes }
}
oe_vas_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR }
                has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active
                AND = { current_date >= 1394.1.1 var:oe_vas_stage = 1 }
            }
        }
        oe_vas_close = yes
    }
    else = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_vas_m add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 3 } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_um add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_rm add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 1 has_variable = oe_vas_galata } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_xm add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 2 } oe_vas_war_monthly = yes }
        else = { oe_vas_peace_monthly = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly outside the war.
oe_vas_peace_monthly = {
    # The agreement: renewed at the same sum when it expires; a breach (stop action or an unpaid January) angers the sultan.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } } }
        if = {
            limit = { c:TUR = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_broken target = c:BYZ } } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_breach } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_vas_breach years = 5 }
                oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = -50 }
            }
            else = { oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = -5 } }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } oe_vas_renew = yes }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = 5 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR var:oe_vas_patience <= 0 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.18
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 1 }
            if = { limit = { oe_vas_army_strong = no } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_weak_m add = 1 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_vas_weak_m value = 0 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 1 var:oe_vas_weak_m >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_done_19 } } oe_vas_fire = { n = 19 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes } oe_vas_schedule = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Renews the tribute agreement with the Ottomans at the recorded sum: 5 years, truce 5 years, no signing costs.
oe_vas_renew = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_tribute }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_vas_tv value = var:oe_vas_tribute }
        c:TUR = { set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace value = scope:oe_vas_tv years = 5 } }
        add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 5 mutual = yes }
        oe_ttb_recount = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. At most one main-line event a month (the caller checked oe_ml_free).
oe_vas_schedule = {
    oe_vas_pick_grand = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 1 }
        if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_3 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_17 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 17 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_16 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 16 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_4 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_vas_consp_cd months = 12 }
            random = { chance = 25 oe_vas_pick_tson = yes oe_vas_fire = { n = 4 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_8 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_vas_esc8_cd months = 12 }
            random = { chance = 30 oe_vas_fire = { n = 8 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_7 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_vas_ven_cd months = 12 }
            random = { chance = 30 oe_vas_fire = { n = 7 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_2 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_vas_serve_cd months = 24 }
            oe_vas_fire_again = { n = 2 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 3 }
        if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_12 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 12 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_13 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 13 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_17 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 17 } }
        # Decision 58: the usurper serves the sultan in the field too. Before .14, whose 10% roll would otherwise block it most months.
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_2 = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_vas_serve_cd months = 24 }
            oe_vas_fire_again = { n = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_vas_ok_14 = yes }
            random = { chance = 10 set_variable = { name = oe_vas_esc14_cd months = 3 } oe_vas_fire_again = { n = 14 } }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_um >= 72 } oe_vas_civil_end = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_vas_stage = 4 }
        if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_15 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 15 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_17 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 17 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_vas_ok_16 = yes } oe_vas_fire = { n = 16 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_galata } } oe_vas_civil_end = yes }
    }
}

# ---- 1 the terms
oe_vas_accept = {
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_begun
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_stage value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_patience value = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_weak_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_serve_cd months = 6 }
    remove_variable = oe_vas_asks
    oe_vas_pick = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
        oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
    }
    # decision 194 (r17): a tooltip preview does not apply oe_ttb_peace_sign's set_variable; read only when set
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_vas_tv value = var:oe_ttb_peace } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_tribute value = scope:oe_vas_tv }
    }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_vas_vassal years = -1 mode = replace }
    activate_situation = situation:oe_vas_vassalage
}
oe_vas_refuse = {
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_refused_op target = c:BYZ } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_refused years = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_asks } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_asks add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_vas_asks value = 1 } }
}
oe_vas_stall = {
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_stall_op target = c:BYZ } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_refused years = 2 }
}
# ---- 4-6 the plot
oe_vas_arrest_heir = {

    set_variable = oe_vas_heir_bitter
}
oe_vas_blind_full = {
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { add_trait = trait:blind imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } }
    var:oe_vas_grand ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { has_trait = blind } } add_trait = trait:blind } }
}

    set_variable = oe_vas_heir_bitter
}
oe_vas_second_heir = {
    var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_vas_sh } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_sh } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_vas_sh }
}
# ---- 7 Tenedos
oe_vas_tenedos_venice = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven years = 20 mode = replace }
    c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven_glad target = c:BYZ } }
    c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_gen_angry target = c:BYZ } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_jewels_in_venice }
        remove_global_variable = oe_cw_jewels_in_venice
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    }
}
# ---- 8-10 escape, the price, the coup
oe_vas_hunt = {
    random_list = {
        40 = {
            var:oe_vas_heir ?= { imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } }
            remove_variable = oe_vas_fugitive
        }
        60 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_vas.9 days = 30 } }
    }
}
oe_vas_outbid = {
    random_list = {
        60 = { set_variable = oe_vas_bribed oe_vas_exile = yes }
        40 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_vas.10 days = 30 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The heir goes to the Genoese of Galata (no war).
oe_vas_exile = {
    remove_variable = oe_vas_fugitive
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN }
        var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } move_country = c:GEN } }
        set_variable = oe_vas_galata
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_xm value = 0 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The usurper rises: an engine civil war from towns near the capital, or a palace coup.
oe_vas_war_start = {
    remove_variable = oe_vas_fugitive
    set_variable = oe_vas_turmoil
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_vas_bribed } } set_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid }
    location:silivri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
    location:corlu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
    location:catalca = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { list = oe_vas_base } } }
        location:vize = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
        location:rodoscuk = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
        location:malgara = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_vas_base } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { in_civil_war = no var:oe_vas_heir ?= { is_alive = yes } any_in_list = { list = oe_vas_base } }
        var:oe_vas_heir = { save_scope_as = oe_vas_lead }
        create_rebel = { category = estate estate = nobles_estate name = OE_VAS_REBELS save_scope_as = oe_vas_rebel_group }
        every_in_list = {
            list = oe_vas_base
            every_pop = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_vas_rebel_group }
        }
        scope:oe_vas_rebel_group = { start_civil_war = { save_scope_as = oe_vas_country } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_country }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_stage value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_rebels value = scope:oe_vas_country }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_tide value = 50 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_guard } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_tide add = 10 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_wm value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_vas_capm value = 0 }
        every_in_list = { list = oe_vas_base if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_location_owner = scope:oe_vas_country } }
        scope:oe_vas_lead = { move_country = scope:oe_vas_country }
        scope:oe_vas_country = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_vas_lead add_gold = 300 }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_vas_base
            limit = { owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
            if = {
                limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid } }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_vas_country }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid } scope:oe_vas_country = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_vas_turk_aid years = 5 mode = replace } } }
        # Disloyal themes that rise join this rebel state; the theme usurpation must not settle this war.
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_country value = scope:oe_vas_country }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_vas_coup
        trigger_event_non_silently = { on_action = oe_vas_coup_roll days = 30 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The palace coup is decided.
oe_vas_coup_roll = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_coup var:oe_vas_heir ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        random = { chance = oe_vas_coup_chance set_variable = oe_vas_coup_won }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_coup_won } remove_variable = oe_vas_coup_won trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.11 }
        else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.20 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_coup } oe_vas_civil_end = yes }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly in the war.
oe_vas_war_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_vas_wm add = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country has_variable = oe_vas_rebels var:oe_theme_revolt_country = var:oe_vas_rebels }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    change_variable = { name = oe_vas_tide add = oe_vas_city_push }
    change_variable = { name = oe_vas_tide add = oe_vas_aid }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_vas_tide min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_rebels ?= { has_ruler = yes } location:constantinople = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_capm add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_vas_capm value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_vas_heir ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
        oe_vas_end_rebels = yes
        oe_vas_civil_end = yes
    }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_vas_tide >= 100 in_civil_war = no } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.20 }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_vas_tide <= 0 var:oe_vas_capm >= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.11 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_wm >= 24 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_vas.21 }
}
# BYZ scope. Brings the usurper home, hands the rebels' towns back and annexes the rebel state (same order as the 1341
# and 1352 wars).
oe_vas_end_rebels = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels } var:oe_vas_rebels = { save_scope_as = oe_vas_r } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_r }
        var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = scope:oe_vas_r } move_country = c:BYZ } }
        if = {
            limit = { in_civil_war = yes }
            every_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_vas_r } change_location_controller = c:BYZ }
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_vas_r reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country var:oe_theme_revolt_country = var:oe_vas_rebels }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    remove_variable = oe_vas_rebels
}
# BYZ scope. The usurper's struggle is over; the vassalage goes on (stage 1).
oe_vas_civil_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_stage value = 1 }
    set_variable = oe_vas_civil_done
    remove_variable = oe_vas_turmoil
    remove_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_venice_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_guard
    remove_variable = oe_vas_coup
    remove_variable = oe_vas_galata
    remove_variable = oe_vas_fugitive
    remove_variable = oe_vas_tide
    remove_variable = oe_vas_wm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_capm
}
# ---- 11 the usurper takes the throne (after the war or the coup)
oe_vas_usurp = {
    oe_vas_end_rebels = yes
    remove_variable = oe_vas_coup
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_vas_uh } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_uh }
        scope:oe_vas_uh = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { owner = c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
            release_character_from_prison_effect = yes
        }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_vas_uh
        var:oe_vas_emp ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 10 } } }
        var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 10 } } }
        var:oe_vas_grand ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ NOT = { has_trait = blind } } save_scope_as = oe_vas_ug } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_ug } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_vas_ug }
        set_global_variable = oe_vas_usurped
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_stage value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_um value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_venice_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_guard
    remove_variable = oe_vas_tide
    remove_variable = oe_vas_wm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_capm
}
# ---- 12 Tenedos promised to Genoa
oe_vas_promise_genoa = {
    c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_gen_glad target = c:BYZ } }
    c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven_angry target = c:BYZ } }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_dispute years = 5 mode = replace }
}
# ---- 14 restoration
oe_vas_restore = {
    var:oe_vas_emp ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_vas_re } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_re }
        scope:oe_vas_re = { release_character_from_prison_effect = yes }
        var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } release_character_from_prison_effect = yes } }
        var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_vas_rh } }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_vas_re
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_rh country_exists = c:GEN }
            scope:oe_vas_rh = { move_country = c:GEN }
            set_variable = oe_vas_galata
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_rh }
            scope:oe_vas_rh = { imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } }
        }
        var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_vas_rs } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_rs } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_vas_rs }
        set_global_variable = oe_vas_restored
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_stage value = 4 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_rm value = 0 }
}
oe_vas_tribute_up = {
    c:TUR = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace multiply = 1.2 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_tribute } change_variable = { name = oe_vas_tribute multiply = 1.2 } }
}
oe_vas_recapture = {
    var:oe_vas_emp ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } } }
    var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_esc14_cd years = 3 }
}
# ---- 15-16 Galata and the settlement
oe_vas_siege_galata = {
    c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_vas_galata_siege target = c:BYZ } }
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_rm value = 12 }
}
oe_vas_talks = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_vas_rm value = 12 }
}
oe_vas_settle_elder = {
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_vas_eh } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_eh }
        scope:oe_vas_eh = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { owner = c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
            release_character_from_prison_effect = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_eh scope:oe_vas_eh = { NOT = { has_trait = blind } } }
        set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_vas_eh
    }
    else = {
        var:oe_vas_grand ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ NOT = { has_trait = blind } } save_scope_as = oe_vas_eg } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_vas_eg } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_vas_eg }
    }
    location:silivri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_vas_selymbria years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_elder_line
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_second_son_slighted
    oe_vas_civil_end = yes
}
oe_vas_settle_second = {
    oe_vas_second_heir = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_second_line
    oe_vas_civil_end = yes
}
# ---- 17 Turin
oe_vas_turin = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_dispute } remove_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_dispute }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_tenedos } remove_country_modifier = oe_br_tenedos }
}
# ---- 18-21 endings
oe_vas_break = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
        oe_ttb_peace_break = yes
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_truce_with = c:TUR } remove_truce_with = c:TUR }
        c:TUR ?= { if = { limit = { has_truce_with = c:BYZ } remove_truce_with = c:BYZ } }
    }
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_broken
    oe_vas_close = yes
}
oe_vas_free_stop = {
    c:TUR = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes } }
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
    add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_freed
    oe_vas_close = yes
}
oe_vas_free_keep = {
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_freed
    oe_vas_close = yes
}
oe_vas_usurper_caught = {
    oe_vas_end_rebels = yes
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 10 } } }
    set_variable = oe_vas_heir_bitter
    oe_vas_civil_end = yes
}
oe_vas_compromise = {
    oe_vas_end_rebels = yes
    oe_vas_settle_elder = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The track ends for good (a quiet end, the sultan's wrath or the yoke thrown off).
oe_vas_close = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_stage ?= 2 } oe_vas_end_rebels = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_vas_vassal } remove_country_modifier = oe_vas_vassal }
    remove_variable = oe_vas_stage
    remove_variable = oe_vas_turmoil
    remove_variable = oe_vas_patience
    remove_variable = oe_vas_m
    remove_variable = oe_vas_um
    remove_variable = oe_vas_rm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_xm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_weak_m
    remove_variable = oe_vas_serve_cd
    remove_variable = oe_vas_consp_cd
    remove_variable = oe_vas_esc8_cd
    remove_variable = oe_vas_ven_cd
    remove_variable = oe_vas_esc14_cd
    remove_variable = oe_vas_breach
    remove_variable = oe_vas_galata
    remove_variable = oe_vas_fugitive
    remove_variable = oe_vas_turks_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_venice_aid
    remove_variable = oe_vas_guard
    remove_variable = oe_vas_coup
    remove_variable = oe_vas_bribed
    remove_variable = oe_vas_tide
    remove_variable = oe_vas_wm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_capm
    remove_variable = oe_vas_rebels
    remove_variable = oe_vas_heir_bitter
    remove_variable = oe_vas_tribute
    remove_variable = oe_vas_tson
    set_global_variable = oe_vas_done
}
